scenes.headline: An orchestrator that is not allowed to touch anything.
scenes.sub: Workers do the work, then get deleted.

scenes.label: The design
scenes.quote: the orchestrator's only action is launching threads; it cannot execute commands or edit files

items.text: A fresh process, a fresh context
Its final answer is the episode

scenes.label: The seam, printed
scenes.quote: a returned error means the environment may have moved ahead of persistent history.
scenes.note: no benchmark, no single-agent baseline yet

scenes.text: A design worth taking seriously and a codebase worth waiting on.

total: The orchestrator cannot act, so its context stays a plan.
